edit.format: cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo fmt
edit.lint: cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::expect_used -W clippy::dbg_macro -W clippy::todo -W clippy::unimplemented

check: if jq -e .scripts.typecheck package.json >/dev/null; then bun run typecheck; else bunx tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess; fi
bunx fallow dead-code || { echo 'Unused code: delete it, or import it from an entry point if it is meant to be used.'; exit 1; }
bunx fallow dupes --threshold 0.01 || { echo 'Duplicated code: extract it into one shared function and reuse it.'; exit 1; }
cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo fmt --check

cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::expect_used -W clippy::dbg_macro -W clippy::todo -W clippy::unimplemented
cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo test -q
cd packages/wgpu && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo deny check -s
